重要实现缺陷上游未复核
F2 · 注册表 OOXML 预览无超时/看门狗，解析 Worker 静默挂起时永久停留 Loading preview

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

office-open-xml-preview.tsx 在 effect 中直接 `await viewer.load(data)` 后再 setLoaded；createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 只传 mode/useGoogleFonts/onError，没有 workerTimeoutMs 等看门狗。@silurus/ooxml 默认在 Worker 中解析，若 Worker 静默死亡，load() 的 promise 不 settle，onError 也不会触发，于是预览既无正文也无失败提示。第一轮验收 B02 因此长期停留 Loading preview（内容与渲染资源均 200、无 loadingFailed），种子与上传样例均复现。

实际影响
内部资料 DOCX 预览在常见失败形态下表现为“永远加载中”，用户得不到任何解释，直接不满足“失败要说明情况”的要求；应用只能自行在安装副本打补丁。
建议改法
在 createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 传入 workerTimeoutMs，或在组件侧为每次 load 增加有限超时并在超时/Worker 失联时销毁 viewer、走既有错误+下载回退（可选重建 Worker 重试一次）。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
打开 DOCX 预览且解析 Worker 静默死亡或长时间无响应（第一轮验收及第二轮长会话录像中均出现 Loading preview 后转为渲染失败）。
应有能力 / 行为
在有限时间内渲染正文；若不能，则在超时内显示本地化失败提示并给出可选下载动作，而不是永久停留在加载中。
实际观察
await viewer.load() 无界且未配置 worker 看门狗，Worker 挂起时 promise 永不 settle，onError 不触发，对话框永久显示 Loading preview。
应用绕行与代价
应用在安装副本中为每次 load 增加超时边界，失败后销毁并重建 viewer/Worker 重试一次，随后 B02 通过。
改进后的验收标准
用一个被 stub 为永不返回的解析 Worker 验证：预览必须在约定超时内显示失败提示并提供下载动作，且不得停留在加载中；正常与失败文件切换后不得出现陈旧状态。

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx:143–180E2

createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 只传入 mode/useGoogleFonts/onError，没有向 @silurus/ooxml viewer 传入 workerTimeoutMs 等 worker 解析看门狗选项。

async function createOfficeOpenXmlViewer(
  format: OfficeOpenXmlFormat,
  host: HTMLElement,
  onError: (error: Error) => void,
): Promise<OfficeOpenXmlViewer> {
  const commonOptions = {
    mode: 'main' as const,
    useGoogleFonts: false,
    onError,
  };
  switch (format) {
    case 'docx': {
      const { DocxScrollViewer } = await import('@silurus/ooxml/docx');
      return new DocxScrollViewer(host, {
        ...commonOptions,
        enableTextSelection: true,
        gap: 16,
        progressiveLayout: true,
      });
    }
    case 'pptx': {
      const { PptxScrollViewer } = await import('@silurus/ooxml/pptx');
      return new PptxScrollViewer(host, {
        ...commonOptions,
        enableTextSelection: true,
        gap: 16,
        progressiveLayout: true,
      });
    }
    case 'xlsx': {
      const { XlsxViewer } = await import('@silurus/ooxml/xlsx');
      return new XlsxViewer(host, {
        ...commonOptions,
        showZoomSlider: true,
      });
    }
  }
}
packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/README.md:9–11E5

README 声称 OOXML 失败会显示错误与可选下载动作，且同源内容请求使用会话 cookie；但未提示 worker 挂起这类不会触发 onError 的失败形态。

Preview handles safe raster images, PDF through a fetched local blob, audio/video and text/Markdown. DOCX/XLSX/PPTX render locally with lazily loaded `@silurus/ooxml`; legacy Office and OpenDocument formats retain Office Online, which requires an internet-accessible absolute URL and cannot use the App session. Active HTML/SVG/XML and unsafe URL schemes are rejected. Markdown does not execute raw HTML.

Follow the plugin Skill's Registry installation and preview sections for the exact viewer dependency, Vite dependency-prebundling exclusion, authentication adapter boundaries and acceptance checks. Same-origin content fetches use session cookies; external fetches omit credentials and require CORS. Bearer-only access requires changes to the App-owned source; setting `contentUrl` to an arbitrary blob URL is not supported. OOXML failures show an error and an optional download action; `download={false}` suppresses that action.

### [重要][实现缺陷] 注册表 OOXML 预览无超时/看门狗，解析 Worker 静默挂起时永久停留 Loading preview

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.16）

office-open-xml-preview.tsx 在 effect 中直接 `await viewer.load(data)` 后再 setLoaded；createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 只传 mode/useGoogleFonts/onError，没有 workerTimeoutMs 等看门狗。@silurus/ooxml 默认在 Worker 中解析，若 Worker 静默死亡，load() 的 promise 不 settle，onError 也不会触发，于是预览既无正文也无失败提示。第一轮验收 B02 因此长期停留 Loading preview（内容与渲染资源均 200、无 loadingFailed），种子与上传样例均复现。

**影响**：内部资料 DOCX 预览在常见失败形态下表现为“永远加载中”，用户得不到任何解释，直接不满足“失败要说明情况”的要求；应用只能自行在安装副本打补丁。

**建议改动**：在 createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 传入 workerTimeoutMs，或在组件侧为每次 load 增加有限超时并在超时/Worker 失联时销毁 viewer、走既有错误+下载回退（可选重建 Worker 重试一次）。

**验收标准**：用一个被 stub 为永不返回的解析 Worker 验证：预览必须在约定超时内显示失败提示并提供下载动作，且不得停留在加载中；正常与失败文件切换后不得出现陈旧状态。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx:56–71` — 注册表 OOXML 预览在 effect 中 `await viewer.load(data)` 后才 setLoaded(true)；全程没有超时/看门狗边界，viewer 静默挂起时既无 onError 也无完成。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx:143–180` — createOfficeOpenXmlViewer 只传入 mode/useGoogleFonts/onError，没有向 @silurus/ooxml viewer 传入 workerTimeoutMs 等 worker 解析看门狗选项。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/README.md:9–11` — README 声称 OOXML 失败会显示错误与可选下载动作，且同源内容请求使用会话 cookie；但未提示 worker 挂起这类不会触发 onError 的失败形态。
- `artifacts/verify-1/browser-acceptance/report.json:29–42` — 第一轮验收 B02 失败：DOCX 预览弹窗 15 秒以上停留在 Loading preview，内容请求与 docx 渲染资源均 200、无 loadingFailed，容器为空；样例与种子文档均复现，判定为系统性缺陷。
- `artifacts/verify-2/browser-acceptance/report.json:30–52` — 第二轮验收 B02 通过，并诚实记录：在长时间运行且屏幕录像的会话中同一 DOCX 曾出现 Loading preview 转为 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' 的偶发失败；干净会话反复验证为正文渲染。

轻微指引错误上游未复核
F4 · 文档称 OOXML 失败会显示错误，但 Worker 静默挂起不触发该回退

文档 / Skill / 示例 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

注册表 README 与插件 SKILL 都声明“OOXML 请求或渲染失败会显示错误并提供下载动作”。该契约对拒绝/抛错成立，但对 Worker 静默挂起这类“既不成功也不报错”的失败不成立——组件无超时，onError 也不会被调用。

评审时 · 文档 / API 声称

OOXML 请求或渲染失败时显示错误和可选下载动作。

评审时 · 实际观察

解析 Worker 静默挂起时预览永久停留 Loading preview，既无错误也无下载回退；第一轮 B02 即为此现象。

实际影响
读者会据此认为失败一定可见，从而忽略超时/看门狗这一必要加固，导致故障表现为无提示的挂起。
建议改法
在 README/SKILL 中补充：worker 驱动的查看器需要超时或 worker 看门狗，并说明挂起不属于 onError 覆盖的失败形态。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
阅读“OOXML 失败显示错误”的文档并在私有环境集成 DOCX 预览。
应有能力 / 行为
文档能提示需要为 worker 解析设置超时/看门狗，否则挂起无提示。
实际观察
文档只描述抛错型失败，未覆盖静默挂起，实际组件也没有超时。
应用绕行与代价
应用在安装副本为 load 增加超时与重试。
改进后的验收标准
文档明确超时/看门狗要求，且提供的默认实现满足该要求。

Registry 组件章节给出 materialize 安装、@silurus/ooxml 版本与 Vite optimizeDeps.exclude 配方，并提示在开发与生产构建中核验解析器 WASM 请求。

## Registry components

The registered Client plugin supplies English and Chinese UI resources. Registry components bind the `@nocobase/app-plugin-file` namespace explicitly; retain the Client registration and `@nocobase/i18n` dependency when installing them. Existing label overrides still take precedence.

Reuse the preinstalled directory when present. For an application without it, materialize `component-ui` from a NocoBase source workspace into the target application:

```bash
pnpm registry materialize --package @nocobase/app-plugin-file --item component-ui --output-root /absolute/path/to/app
```

Materialize copies source only and refuses an existing target directory. Run it from the NocoBase source repository, not from a generated application. For an upgrade, materialize into a separate temporary directory and three-way merge the previous Registry source, new source and application copy; preserve application customizations. The App must provide React/React DOM, lucide-react, react-markdown, remark-gfm and shadcn button/dialog primitives. It adds no route or permissions. A hosted Registry JSON can instead be installed with shadcn add, which reads the item's declared dependencies; npm publication alone supplies no Registry URL.

Default already declares the viewer. For an application installing the source or upgrading an older copy, add the OOXML viewer from the target App directory if missing:

```bash
pnpm add -D --save-exact @silurus/ooxml@0.85.1
```

The viewer belongs in the App's `devDependencies`: Vite compiles this application-owned client source. Registry `dependencies` describes the installation recipe, while a plugin's published runtime Client imports belong in that plugin's `peerDependencies`. Do not move this viewer into server `dependencies` or add it as a plugin peer solely for copied Registry source. Retain the registered file Client plugin for its locale resources. Merge Registry upgrades with App customizations instead of overwriting installed source.

Use a version of `@nocobase/dev-config` whose `createAppViteConfig` excludes `@silurus/ooxml` from dependency prebundling. For an older shared preset or custom Vite configuration, merge this entry into the existing configuration and preserve other exclusions:

```ts
optimizeDeps: {
  exclude: ['@silurus/ooxml'],
},
```

Restart the development server after changing the configuration. This exclusion preserves the viewer's `import.meta.url`-relative WASM paths during development; verify the parser WASM requests in both development and the served production build.

SKILL 说明 accessPath、policy/principal、上传继承 create.defaults，并明确内容路由是 public、Policy 不及它；要求为受限文件在归属路径注册应用自有认证，且“仅缺内置鉴权不能成为替换这些路由的理由”。

`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/routes.js:20–73E6

defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 以 policy+principal 声明上传/CRUD：无 principal 时 403，upload 从 create 作用域继承 defaults；content 路由被注释明确标为 public、鉴权归应用所有。

const unwritablePolicy = {
    read: false,
    create: false,
    update: false,
    delete: false,
};
/** Public first-version routes. Authentication and authorization are application-owned. */
export function defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes(options) {
    const paths = [];
    const entries = options.repositories.map((entry) => {
        const accessPath = normalizeAccessPath(entry.accessPath ?? `/uploads/${entry.name}`);
        if (paths.some((path) => path === accessPath ||
            path.startsWith(`${accessPath}/`) ||
            accessPath.startsWith(`${path}/`)))
            throw new Error(`Conflicting file accessPath: ${accessPath}`);
        paths.push(accessPath);
        if (!entry.disk)
            throw new Error('File repository disk is required.');
        if (entry.accessMode !== undefined &&
            !['stream', 'redirect'].includes(entry.accessMode))
            throw new Error('Invalid file accessMode.');
        const { uploadOne, uploadMany, ...actions } = entry.actions;
        for (const upload of [uploadOne, uploadMany]) {
            if (upload === undefined)
                continue;
            if (!upload ||
                typeof upload !== 'object' ||
                Object.keys(upload).some((key) => key !== 'maxSize'))
                throw new Error('Invalid upload action configuration.');
            if (upload.maxSize !== undefined &&
                (!Number.isSafeInteger(upload.maxSize) || upload.maxSize <= 0))
                throw new Error('maxSize must be a positive safe integer.');
        }
        return { ...entry, accessPath, actions, uploadOne, uploadMany };
    });
    const crud = defineRepositoryApiRoutes({
        principal: options.principal,
        repositories: entries.map(({ name, collection, connection, policy, actions }) => ({
            name,
            collection,
            connection,
            policy,
            actions,
        })),
    });
    const resolve = (app, entry, policy) => app.container
        .resolve(serverFileRepositoryManagerToken)
        .repository(entry.collection ?? entry.name, {
        connection: entry.connection,
        disk: entry.disk,
        accessPath: entry.accessPath,
        policy,
    });
    const urlFor = (app, files) => (record) => `${(app.publicBasePath ?? '').replace(/\/$/, '')}${files.getUrl(record)}`;

export function FileThumbnail({
  file,
  url,
  alt = file.filename,
}: FileThumbnailProps): ReactElement {
  const imageUrl = resolveSafeFileUrl(
    url ?? (isSafeImagePreview(file) ? (file.contentUrl ?? '') : ''),
  );
  return imageUrl ? (
    <img
      data-slot='file-thumbnail'
      src={imageUrl}
      alt={alt}
      className='h-full w-full object-cover'
    />

    <span

      aria-label={file.filename}
      className='flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-muted/50 p-3 text-muted-foreground'

      {icon(file)}

实现者过程与运行背景 · 6 个过程问题 / 2 条建议 · 不自动归为框架问题

本任务已处理只描述应用侧处理结果，不代表 NocoBase3 上游已修复。

本轮过程记录

Issue #507 project materials (资料) with private attachments is implemented: a projectMaterials collection, an authenticated CRUD API and private byte route, a localized /materials page, and an idempotent demo seed with two isolated accounts. A repair pass also fixed the DOCX preview that could hang forever on "Loading preview...": the @silurus/ooxml viewer always parses in a Worker and its parse watchdog stays off unless workerTimeoutMs is supplied, so a silently dead Worker left load() pending with no onError. The preview now bounds each load attempt, retries once with a fresh viewer/Worker, and explains the failure instead of spinning.

问题 01 · 实现阶段

Authenticated cookie writes returned 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN in tests

本任务已处理

POST to the app's own API from the test host failed with 403 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN.

原因（实现者自述）
auth.required() runs checkCookieWriteOrigin for non-GET requests carrying a cookie; the test client sent no Origin and no APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN was configured.
处理方式
Set APP_PUBLIC_ORIGIN in the test server env and have the request helper set Origin on cookie writes.
影响 / 代价：Short: diagnosed from the auth middleware trace.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 02 · 实现阶段

Seed importing a server module with a relative .js specifier failed ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND

本任务已处理

The demo seed threw ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND at load time.

原因（实现者自述）
The migration/seed task loader imports the raw .ts over a file:// URL with an mtime query; __rewriteRelativeImportExtension never rewrites it, so Node's native TS loader runs and does not map '.js' to '.ts'.
处理方式
Made the seed self-contained (only bare package specifiers).
影响 / 代价：Short.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · 实现阶段

Provider start() threw COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND under embedded-scope test hosts

本任务已处理

Demo attachment provisioning failed when the host had no migrations.

原因（实现者自述）
Those hosts run against a temp app root with no database/main/migrations, so the collection is never created.
处理方式
provisionDemoAttachmentBytes reads the collection first and returns early when it is absent.
影响 / 代价：Short.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 04 · 实现阶段

Corrupted images fell back silently to the filename, reading as preview success

本任务已处理

A corrupted PNG showed only its filename with no explanation.

原因（实现者自述）
The image preview had no load-error handling.
处理方式
FileThumbnail and ImagePreview use a failedUrl derived-state pattern to render an explanatory fallback; the preview fallback is wrapped in role='alert' so it is assertable.
影响 / 代价：Short.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 05 · 实现阶段

react-hooks/set-state-in-effect blocked synchronous failure state in an effect

本任务已处理

Setting the failure state directly in an effect was an ESLint error.

原因（实现者自述）
The react-hooks/set-state-in-effect rule treats synchronous setState in effects as an error.
处理方式
Used a derived failedUrl comparison instead of effect-driven state, and set load state inside promise callbacks.
影响 / 代价：Short.来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 06 · 修复阶段

DOCX preview stayed on "Loading preview..." forever with an empty container

本任务已处理

QA reported the DOCX preview dialog hanging on "Loading preview..." for >15s for both a freshly uploaded sample.docx and the seeded site-document.docx. Live DOM showed the [data-office-open-xml-format="docx"] host present, role=status "Loading preview...", zero canvases, no alert, and an inner sizer of width:1px; height:0px. A hard reload of the same URL rendered fine, and page.workers() was 0 in the stuck state.

原因（实现者自述）
@silurus/ooxml always parses in a Worker (new Worker from an inline blob), even in mode:'main'. Its parse watchdog is armed only when the workerTimeoutMs option is supplied: _rearmParseWatchdog() starts a timer only if this._parseWatchdogMs !== undefined. The parse request is posted with timeoutMs: false (no request timeout) and _parseProgressively awaits firstPublication.promise, which resolves only on a layoutPartial push. With no workerTimeoutMs, a Worker that dies or stalls silently produces no progress and no error; load() never settles and onError never fires, so the dialog spins forever. The library's own watchdog would terminate the worker and reject with "worker layout produced no progress".
处理方式
In office-open-xml-preview.tsx, pass workerTimeoutMs: 10000 so the library's progress-based watchdog arms and rejects load() after 10s of silence, retry once with a fresh viewer/Worker, and bound each load with a last-resort `withTimeout(..., 60_000)` so no viewer can ever leave the dialog spinning. Each attempt gets its own data.slice(0) because load() transfers/detaches the buffer. A per-attempt token keeps a late onError from a replaced viewer from condemning the replacement. The t translation is kept out of the effect deps via a ref so a re-render cannot restart the fetch or worker. The final failure renders the localized fallback alert rather than a silent filename. The watchdog is progress-based (re-armed on every layout push), so a large document that keeps making progress is not cut off.
影响 / 代价：Long: required byte-level source analysis of the minified bundle (canvas-viewer-mechanics and bounded-raw-part-cache chunks) plus a live reproduction of the stall by stubbing the parser Worker, after ruling out the wasm fetch, service workers, background throttling, document.fonts.ready, and connection-pool exhaustion.来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 验收机制

Reproduce a silent-worker stall by stubbing Worker, not by network blocking

需人工判断

Blocking the wasm chunk or the async viewer chunk yields role=alert through onError, which never exercised the hang. Stubbing only blob: Worker constructions leaves the fetch healthy and the parser silent, reproducing the exact QA symptom on the pre-fix build. Playwright's addInitScript is enough.

建议改动

Keep a small browser repro that stubs blob Workers for OOXML preview regressions.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · component

Bound third-party viewer loads and retry once on a fresh instance

可自动化

A viewer whose background Worker dies silently has no error channel. Telling the library to watch for silence (workerTimeoutMs) plus one retry on a fresh viewer/Worker converts a transient stall into a recovery and a real failure into an explanation within about 20s. A last-resort bound guards against a viewer that never settles at all. Retrying beats a timeout-only fallback because a hover reload of the stuck page recovers.

建议改动

When integrating a worker-backed viewer, always pass its watchdog option and wrap load() in a bounded retry.

来源：Agent · retro.json

async function createOfficeOpenXmlViewer(
  format: OfficeOpenXmlFormat,
  host: HTMLElement,
  onError: (error: Error) => void,
): Promise<OfficeOpenXmlViewer> {
  const commonOptions = {
    mode: 'main' as const,
    useGoogleFonts: false,
    onError,
  };
  switch (format) {
    case 'docx': {
      const { DocxScrollViewer } = await import('@silurus/ooxml/docx');
      return new DocxScrollViewer(host, {
        ...commonOptions,
        enableTextSelection: true,
        gap: 16,
        progressiveLayout: true,
      });
    }
    case 'pptx': {
      const { PptxScrollViewer } = await import('@silurus/ooxml/pptx');
      return new PptxScrollViewer(host, {
        ...commonOptions,
        enableTextSelection: true,
        gap: 16,
        progressiveLayout: true,
      });
    }
    case 'xlsx': {
      const { XlsxViewer } = await import('@silurus/ooxml/xlsx');
      return new XlsxViewer(host, {
        ...commonOptions,
        showZoomSlider: true,
      });
    }
  }
}

E9 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/client/manager.js:1–35

ClientFileRepositoryManager.repository(name) 的 uploadOne/uploadMany 以 multipart 向 `/<name>:uploadOne|uploadMany` POST，是应用侧无需自定义适配器的上传契约。

export class ClientFileRepositoryManager {
    api;
    constructor(api) {
        this.api = api;
    }
    repository(name) {
        const api = this.api;
        const repository = api.repository(name);
        return Object.assign(repository, {
            async uploadOne({ file }, options) {
                const body = new FormData();
                body.append('file', file);
                const { data } = await api.request({
                    path: `/${encodeURIComponent(name)}:uploadOne`,
                    method: 'POST',
                    body,
                    signal: options?.signal,
                });
                return data;
            },
            async uploadMany({ files }, options) {
                const body = new FormData();
                for (const file of files)
                    body.append('file', file);
                const { data } = await api.request({
                    path: `/${encodeURIComponent(name)}:uploadMany`,
                    method: 'POST',
                    body,
                    signal: options?.signal,
                });
                return data;
            },
        });
    }
}

E10 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:116–127

SKILL 说明 accessPath、policy/principal、上传继承 create.defaults，并明确内容路由是 public、Policy 不及它；要求为受限文件在归属路径注册应用自有认证，且“仅缺内置鉴权不能成为替换这些路由的理由”。

`name` is the Client resource; `collection` defaults to name, `connection` to the database default, and `accessPath` to `/uploads/<name>`. Disk is required. Content paths contain static alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen segments, start with `/`, and have no trailing slash.

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

E11 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:161–189

Registry 组件章节给出 materialize 安装、@silurus/ooxml 版本与 Vite optimizeDeps.exclude 配方，并提示在开发与生产构建中核验解析器 WASM 请求。

## Registry components

The registered Client plugin supplies English and Chinese UI resources. Registry components bind the `@nocobase/app-plugin-file` namespace explicitly; retain the Client registration and `@nocobase/i18n` dependency when installing them. Existing label overrides still take precedence.

Reuse the preinstalled directory when present. For an application without it, materialize `component-ui` from a NocoBase source workspace into the target application:

```bash
pnpm registry materialize --package @nocobase/app-plugin-file --item component-ui --output-root /absolute/path/to/app
```

Materialize copies source only and refuses an existing target directory. Run it from the NocoBase source repository, not from a generated application. For an upgrade, materialize into a separate temporary directory and three-way merge the previous Registry source, new source and application copy; preserve application customizations. The App must provide React/React DOM, lucide-react, react-markdown, remark-gfm and shadcn button/dialog primitives. It adds no route or permissions. A hosted Registry JSON can instead be installed with shadcn add, which reads the item's declared dependencies; npm publication alone supplies no Registry URL.

Default already declares the viewer. For an application installing the source or upgrading an older copy, add the OOXML viewer from the target App directory if missing:

```bash
pnpm add -D --save-exact @silurus/ooxml@0.85.1
```

The viewer belongs in the App's `devDependencies`: Vite compiles this application-owned client source. Registry `dependencies` describes the installation recipe, while a plugin's published runtime Client imports belong in that plugin's `peerDependencies`. Do not move this viewer into server `dependencies` or add it as a plugin peer solely for copied Registry source. Retain the registered file Client plugin for its locale resources. Merge Registry upgrades with App customizations instead of overwriting installed source.

Use a version of `@nocobase/dev-config` whose `createAppViteConfig` excludes `@silurus/ooxml` from dependency prebundling. For an older shared preset or custom Vite configuration, merge this entry into the existing configuration and preserve other exclusions:

```ts
optimizeDeps: {
  exclude: ['@silurus/ooxml'],
},
```

Restart the development server after changing the configuration. This exclusion preserves the viewer's `import.meta.url`-relative WASM paths during development; verify the parser WASM requests in both development and the served production build.

    required(options = {}) {
        return async (context, next) => {
            const originFailure = await this.checkCookieWriteOrigin(context);
            if (originFailure)
                return originFailure;
            if (options.skip?.(context)) {
                await next();
                return;
            }
            let auth;
            try {
                auth = await this.getSession(context.req.raw.headers);
                // A refused credential is Better Auth's APIError; answer with its own status and body.
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (error instanceof APIError) {
                    return context.json(error.body ?? { code: error.status, message: error.message }, error.statusCode);
                }
                throw error;
            }
            if (!auth) {
                return context.json({
                    code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
                    message: 'Authentication required',
                }, 401);
            }
            context.set('auth', auth);
            await next();
        };

E18 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:129–139

DB SKILL 规定迁移自包含、合并后不可变、文件名与 name 一致、不可逆时声明 irreversible；seed 幂等并以 upsertOne 表达，且两者默认在事务中运行。

The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm nocobase db redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Both run inside a transaction by default. `transaction: false` opts out, and a failure then leaves partial work behind with no history record, so take it only when the operation genuinely cannot run in one.

E19 · app/.agents/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:272–290

事务章节要求只使用回调交给的 connection，外层 db.repository/query/builder 不会随事务回滚；返回即提交、抛错即回滚。

## 5. Transactions

```ts
await db.transaction(async (connection) => {
  await connection.repository('orders').createOne({ values: order });
  await connection.query
    .updateTable('inventory')
    .set({ reserved: true })
    .where('sku', '=', order.sku)
    .execute();
});
```

Use only the `connection` the callback hands you. Calling the outer `db.query()`, `db.builder()`, `db.repository()` or `db.connection()` inside the callback runs outside the transaction and will not roll back with it — the same applies to metadata work, which must go through the transaction connection's `collectionMetadata` and `collections`.

Returning commits; throwing rolls back. Swallowing an error inside the callback and continuing commits the partial work.

A Repository nested write opens its own transaction when none is active and joins an existing one when there already is, without a savepoint per write. Several independent calls that must roll back together need an explicit transaction around them.

E49 · app/server/providers/project-material.ts:329–343

应用 openAttachment 先按 ownerId 过滤，再 drive.use(file.disk).exists/getStream，未命中即 404；这是应用自有的记录级访问控制实现。

  async openAttachment(
    userId: string,
    fileId: string,
  ): Promise<{ file: ProjectMaterialFileRecord; stream: Readable }> {
    const file = await this.files().findOne({ filter: { id: fileId } });
    if (!file || file.ownerId !== userId) throw notFound();

    const disk = this.drive.use(file.disk);
    if (!(await disk.exists(file.key))) throw notFound();

    return {
      file: this.toFileRecord(file),
      stream: await disk.getStream(file.key),
    };
  }

  2. 详情内 Preview 渲染出真实图片：页面 img[alt=sample.png] naturalWidth=32、naturalHeight=32，src 指向 /main/api/project-material-files/5e2bc9a4-0c81-4699-8b0f-457d7670386c.png
